_about: Reference ranges per weapon type (SI units: metres, kilograms). Every range names its source. A range with source null is a guess: it can only produce REVIEW, never FAIL. Replace guesses with measured or sourced data (CONTRIBUTING: evidence first). 'fantasy' widens the realistic range by the style factors below, but the character-use checks (grip fits the hands, weapon not taller than the character) always apply.

character.source: hand breadth: NASA anthropometry via healthline.com/health/average-hand-size (men 8.9 cm, women 7.9 cm); 1.80 m = common game mannequin height (guess)

fantasy.physics_source: scripts/mass_balance.py (author's research script, not in this repository) and MASTER_RULEBOOK sec. 12: fantasy = a wide warning band only for mass/balance; geometry checks stay FAIL-level (agreed with ChatGPT, 2026-10-18). Changed by the user 2026-10-27: real-world geometry ranges (overall, blade, grip, thickness) are INFO only (geometry_info_only); scale/units, grip fits the hands and size vs the character stay gates

densities.source: steel 7850 kg/m3 (standard value); grip 1200 = wood/leather over a steel tang (guess); wood 600 (typical ash/fir, guess)
